Holy Smite (Azata Good4 Evoc): R300' Evil creatures in a 20' radius suffer 5d8 HP, or 10d6 HP if they are outsiders, and are blinded for 1 rd (save Will half HP only); neutral creatures suffer half HP only (save Will half)
Holy Word (Azata Good7 Evoc): Inflicts on nongood creatures within 40' a set of effects: banishment for 24 hr (save Will -4 negates) on extraplanar creatures; killed or destroyed on creatures with up to 10 HD (save Will inflicts 3d6+20 HP; paralyzed for 1d10 min on creatures with up to 15 HD (save Will inflicts paralyzed for 1 rd); blinded for 2d4 rd on creatures with up to 19 HD (save Will inflicts blinded for 1d4 rd); deafened for 1d4 rd on creatures with up to 20 HD (save negates)
Implosion (Catastrophe9 Evoc): R75' Inflicts 200 HP (save Fortitude negates) on 1 target per rd for concentration up to 10 rd
Inflict Critical Wounds (Catastrophe4 Necr): Touched suffers 4d8+20 HP (save Will half); undead instead regain the same amount

Shout (Catastrophe5 Evoc): 30' cone inflicts 5d6 HP sonic (or 20d6 HP sonic to crystalline creatures and objects) and deafened for 2d6 rd (save Fortitude half HP only; save Reflex negates damage to held objects)
Summon Monster IX (Azata Good9 Conj): R75' Summons 1 9th-level, 1d3 8th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
